offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures electric power steering, steer-by-wire and driveline systems for vehicles. Sells them to global automakers under multi-year supply contracts, and makes them in its own plants.

primary_products.value: electric power steering systems; steer-by-wire systems; e-axles; driveline systems; halfshafts

primary_services.value: engineering and development services for automakers

customer_segment.value: B2B: global automakers and electric vehicle makers

revenue_model.value: product sales: steering and driveline components sold to automakers; project or contract: engineering development contracts and program awards

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: takes in purchased parts and metal, sells steering and driveline modules to automakers; OEM / manufacturer: designs and builds its own steering and driveline products in its plants

geography_served.value: global: plants and customers in North America, Europe, China and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: steering systems and driveline and e-axle products sold to the same automaker customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sells directly to global automakers; own locations: manufacturing plants and engineering centers worldwide

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: automotive safety and functional safety standards such as FMVSS and ISO 26262
